item.text:
Created the Rust 2021 project in `/output` with the entrypoint [test13.rs](/output/test13.rs), Cargo manifest [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml), and library modules under [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs) and [src/inflection/mod.rs](/output/src/inflection/mod.rs). The implementation uses only `std`, takes `argv[1]` the same way as the C++ program, and reproduces the same 13-line output behavior.

It compiles with both `cargo build --release` and `rustc --edition 2021 /output/test13.rs -o /output/test13`. I verified the Rust binary byte-for-byte against `/workspace/dataset/test13_executable` over a broad input set including the provided examples, empty-string args, spaces, underscores, hyphens, uppercase sequences, digits, and a few non-ASCII samples. The standalone executable is at `/output/test13`, and the Cargo release build is at `/output/target/release/test13`.
